import argparse, json, time

import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/runs')
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Initial depth/camera-calibrated locations. The first fruit is the lower lemon.

    'lemon_lower': np.array([0.386, -0.102, 0.012]),
}

PLACE = {
    'left': np.array([0.399, -0.397, 0.035]),
    'right': np.array([0.377, -0.244, 0.028]),
}

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('mode', choices=['observe','move','pose'])
p.add_argument('--name', default='action')
p.add_argument('--x', type=float); p.add_argument('--y', type=float); p.add_argument('--z', type=float)
p.add_argument('--grip', type=float, default=0.0)
p.add_argument('--video', choices=['both','frames','mp4','none'], default='both')
a = p.parse_args()
r = Robot()
if a.mode == 'observe':
    o = r.get_obs(depth=True, video='none')
    from PIL import Image
    for c, im in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f"observe_{c}.jpg")
    for c, d in o.last_depth.items(): np.save(OUT / f"observe_depth_{c}.npy", d)
    print(json.dumps({'meta':o.meta,'tcp_pose':o.meta['proprio']['now'][8:15]},indent=2))
    raise SystemExit

now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=['egocentric_mirrored_camera'],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'],float)
if a.mode == 'pose':
    if None in (a.x,a.y,a.z): raise SystemExit('pose requires --x --y --z')
    xyz = [a.x,a.y,a.z]
else:
    if a.name == 'pregrasp': xyz = [0.386,-0.102,0.190]
    elif a.name == 'grasp': xyz = PICK['lemon_lower'].tolist()
    elif a.name == 'lift': xyz = [0.386,-0.102,0.200]
    elif a.name == 'place_left': xyz = PLACE['left'].tolist()
    elif a.name == 'place_right': xyz = PLACE['right'].tolist()
    elif a.name == 'retreat': xyz = [0.386,-0.102,0.200]
    else: raise SystemExit(f'unknown named target {a.name}')
pose = np.asarray([*xyz, *now[11:15], float(a.grip)],dtype=np.float32)
# Store planned target and current state alongside the returned camera/proprio data.

res.save(str(out))
Path(out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps({'mode':a.mode,'name':a.name,'target':pose.tolist(),'meta':res.meta},indent=2))
print('RESULT',json.dumps({'out':str(out),'done':res.meta.get('done'),'reason':res.meta.get('reason'),
